subject: Culture
title: The Fusion Fear
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Fusion Fear.

hook.text: A sushi burrito outrages purists. A Korean taco delights adventurers. Fusion splits opinion.

buildup.text: Fusion cuisine blends traditions. Critics call it cultural theft. Fans call it evolution.

discovery.text: All cuisine is fusion if you go back far enough. Tomatoes are American—Italian food adopted them.

twist.text: Thai food's signature chilies came from Portuguese traders. The 'authentic' was once foreign.

climax.text: Purity in food is a myth. Every cuisine is a record of contact, trade, and migration.

punchline.text: Authentic just means 'old enough to forget the borrowing.'

quiz.question: Where did tomatoes originate before becoming central to Italian cuisine?
